{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rule of Celebration''' was an underlying principal that the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]] adhered to when throwing parties and celebrations. The Rule stated that "all are invited regardless of who hosts the party, and no one ever goes away unsatisfied."<ref name="Marvel">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
